title: Bot-to-agent handoff loses context on chat
scenario: After a flow release, LFG chat agents get an empty assistant panel on every bot handoff while voice works. Customers say they told the bot everything. You get flow logs, Lex conversation logs, contact records for both channels, agent panel captures, the flows and the new shared handoff module.
task: Find where the bot context is lost, with quoted evidence from flow logs, Lex logs and CTRs
Explain why voice is unaffected and UAT passed; rule out the persistent-chat red herring
Fix the chat path so it hands over the same context as voice, keeping the shared module
Verify with lint, tests and a regenerated bundle
acceptance: Chat handoffs carry lexIntent, botSummary, lexSlots, callerVerified, handoffSource for every intent
Voice and chat parity; routing and bot-timeout behavior unchanged
The module no longer depends on data a flow module cannot read
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md
